713:t_019:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$次元将$$ $$ヴィルダーク$$... When you see $$ガイオウ$$, tell him...」

713:t_019:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...that we're fighting against a future of despair.」

713:t_020:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... could not repay the lives I took...」

713:t_020:2.en:
$n
「Repaying them matters... But if you call yourself a general, you should have sought something you could do for the living.」

713:t_020:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... Is that the answer you reached, beyond both hope and despair...?」

713:t_020:4.en:
$n
「...I don't know if it is an answer...」

713:t_020:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... $$悲しみの乙女$$, $$傷だらけの獅子$$, $$揺れる天秤$$...」

713:t_020:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Any of you will do. Take my four $$スフィア$$s. You achieved $$真化融合$$, so you should be able to.」

713:t_020:7.en:
$n
「...I can't do that to someone who's lost the will to fight...」

713:t_021:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The cursed wanderer, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... Have the $$スフィア$$s drawn you here too?」

713:t_021:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$次元将$$ $$ヴィルダーク$$. I will carry on your wishes.」

713:t_021:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's dirty, $$アサキム$$! You're going to steal the $$スフィア$$s?!」

713:t_021:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will scavenge corpses or do anything else if it lets me take revenge on them.」

713:t_021:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Either of you will do, as long as you defeat the $$御使い$$. I leave the rest to you.」

713:t_022:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...this is what happens.」

713:t_023:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have taken back your four $$スフィア$$s.」

713:t_023:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ of Joy...!」

713:t_023:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アウストラリス$$... $$アドナキエル$$ the General...」

713:t_023:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「In recognition of your achievements, I took your life without making you suffer.」

713:t_023:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $$アドナキエル$$.」

713:t_023:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Don't call me by that name!」

713:t_023:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am... $$次元将$$ $$ヴィルダーク$$!!」

713:t_024:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You seem dissatisfied, $$アサキム$$.」

713:t_024:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But this is a rightful act, since we were the original owners of the $$スフィア$$s.」

713:t_024:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I cannot forgive that arrogance.」

713:t_025:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That was a wise decision. He knows his own strength.」

713:t_025:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「At any rate, four $$スフィア$$s have now returned to us.」

713:t_025:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I frightened you earlier, $n.」

713:t_025:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But rest assured. I will never abandon you.」

713:t_025:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't think of us as your possessions!」

713:t_025:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That does not apply only to you.」

713:t_025:8.en:
$n
「Are you going to fight us with those $$スフィア$$s?」

713:t_025:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You really do understand nothing, $n.」

713:t_025:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The $$スフィア$$s are not power for fighting. They are meant to save this universe.」

713:t_025:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I will be waiting, $c. Your power is needed to save the entire universe too.」

713:t_026:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's useless, $n. He retreated by teleporting.」

713:t_026:2.en:
$$桂$$
「But showing himself before us was his mistake.」

713:t_026:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Today's battle also suggests that the $$御使い$$ of Sorrow has different aims from $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and the others.」

713:t_026:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then is she on our side...?」

713:t_026:5.en:
$n
「We can clear everything up at their headquarters.」

713:t_026:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return immediately. We will follow the $$烙印$$ and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s trail, and teleport after him.」

713:t_026:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just you wait, $$御使い$$s! We won't waver or hesitate anymore!」

713:t_026:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The possibility inside us... We just have to believe in it and fight...!」

713:t_026:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「Now it is our turn to invade your territory! We will pay you back for everything!」

713:t_026:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Goodbye, $$ヴィルダーク$$... I still can't accept you...)

713:t_026:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
(But I'll fulfill your wishes and $$尸空#pilot$$'s by defeating them.)

713:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn it... Damn it...! Our fight hasn't been for nothing, has it?!」

713:t_100:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Dad, Grandpa, Big Bro $$イチ$$! I... I!!」

713:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(This helplessness... It's just like the day I fled Mars...)

713:t_101:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(Am I... going to be devoured by despair...?)

713:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've overcome crises like this so many times before! This time too... we will, for sure!」

713:t_102:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Damn it! Then why am I so scared?! Somebody tell me!!」

713:t_103:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I can't give up! If I give up, $$鉄人$$ won't be able to fight either!」

713:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Now is when I have to muster my courage...! So why...?!」

713:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Where there is hope, light is born...! If despair swallows us, it's all over!」

713:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I have to overcome this despair! Otherwise, it's over for both me and Earth!」

713:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「My gut is telling me...! This is nothing like the hells we've been through before!」

713:t_105:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Can we not win...?! Against them, or against fate...?!」

713:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「The darkness in my heart is trying to crush me completely...!」

713:t_106:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Tell me, Brother...! What should I... what should we do...?!」

713:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I can't fire up my body or my heart... Is this what despair is...?!」

713:t_107:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Are we... am I... going to end here...?!」

713:t_108:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I never felt like this even when facing hordes of $$宇宙怪獣$$...」
